_note: Original heuristics written for this project. Semantics cross-checked against the scipy and statsmodels documentation listed in references.

statistical_tests.when: numeric outcome, 2 independent groups, ~normal or n>=30 each
statistical_tests.caveats: default over Student t; handles unequal variances

statistical_tests.when: numeric outcome, 2 independent groups, non-normal or ordinal
statistical_tests.caveats: rank-based; a median-shift reading needs similar shapes
robust to unequal variances; add corrected post-hoc tests
omnibus only; locate differences with a post-hoc (Dunn)
zero differences are dropped by default

statistical_tests.when: 2 categorical variables, expected counts >= 5 per cell
2 categorical variables, 2x2 table, any expected count < 5
statistical_tests.caveats: exact; chi-square is the large-count alternative

statistical_tests.when: 2 numeric or ordinal variables, monotonic association
statistical_tests.caveats: rank-based; robust to outliers and nonlinearity

statistical_tests.when: 2 group proportions (e.g. conversion rates), large counts
statistical_tests.caveats: small counts: Fisher exact on the 2x2 counts instead

statistical_tests.when: normality check before choosing a test
statistical_tests.caveats: p-value may be inaccurate for n > 5000; confirm with a Q-Q plot

chart_selection.chart: bar chart (horizontal when labels are long)
chart_selection.caveats: value axis starts at zero; sort unless order is natural

chart_selection.chart: grouped bar (2 series) or small multiples (3+)
chart_selection.caveats: grouped bars get unreadable past ~2 series
keep the time axis continuous; never truncate it
cap at ~5 lines; label lines directly
bin width changes the story; try several widths

chart_selection.chart: bar of shares; pie only if <= 5 slices
chart_selection.caveats: never a pie over 5 slices; avoid 3D and donut variants

chart_selection.chart: 100% stacked bar across a second dimension
chart_selection.caveats: only the baseline segment compares easily; keep segment order fixed
large n overplots: sample, add transparency, or hexbin

chart_selection.chart: funnel or ordered bar of stage counts
chart_selection.caveats: preserve stage order; rates relative to the first stage
